name: Password Field
hint: Type a password and watch the rules tick.
description: Password input with a show/hide toggle, a segmented strength meter that fills as rules are met, and a live rule checklist.
usage: Use wherever someone types a password. To create or change one, keep the meter and rules (autocomplete is "new-password"). To sign in, set showRules and showStrength to false: the field becomes a plain password box with autocomplete="current-password". Give it `name`, and `value` + `onChange` if you own the state; show a wrong-password or server error with `error`. The ref is the <input>; unknown props (aria-*, data-*) go to it. A <form> reset clears it back to `defaultValue`. Replace the checklist with your own policy through `rules` ([{ label, test }]); all copy can be changed through `messages`. The label sits above the box by default; in a form with Text Field (which floats its label by default), Textarea or Tag Input, give every field the same `labelPlacement` so the form reads as one design, and `icon="none"` when the other fields have no icon. Bump `revealErrors` on every submit so a repeated error still shakes.

keyboard.does: Moves from the input to the show/hide button.
Types into the input; the strength line and the checklist update as you type.
Shows the password, or hides it again.

screenReader: A password input named by `label`. The strength level, "Strong password" or `error` is linked with aria-describedby and read in a live region, and an error sets aria-invalid. The show/hide button keeps the name `messages.show` and says whether the password is shown with aria-pressed; the checklist is a list named `messages.rulesLabel` whose items each say met or not met, and the bar meter is hidden from screen readers.

dataProps.description: Visible label. "" for none (then pass aria-label).

"above": a static label over a 48px box (52px on phones and touch). "float": the label sits inside a 56px box and floats up on focus or once there is a value, as Text Field draws it by default. Give every field in a form the same value so the labels read as one design.
Leading icon (18px, --ts-ink2): any name from the kit's icon set, or "none" to match fields that have no icon.
Controlled value: pass it with onChange. Leave undefined to let the field keep its own (seeded by defaultValue).
